sheet.p: Every figure here is the company's. Save writes it to the company at once; there is no second copy to keep in step. The administrator's own Settings page shows the same fields.

field.name: clearance_oop_account_id
field.help: Balance-sheet account holding recoverable client disbursements until the invoice clears them.

field.name: clearance_oop_payable_account_id
field.help: Where an approved disbursement waits between being approved and being paid. Name it and the vendor is credited as soon as the disbursement is approved; paying it moves the debit across to Débours Engagés, which is what billing recharges. Leave it empty and nothing posts until payment.

field.name: clearance_advance_account_id
field.help: Where cash advances sit until justified with supporting documents.

field.name: clearance_fee_account_id
field.help: Fallback for fee lines, used only where the two accounts below are left empty.

field.name: clearance_oop_undercharge_account_id
field.help: Expense account for what was disbursed for the client but deliberately not recharged. 47xx still clears in full; the shortfall is booked here as a cost.

field.name: clearance_oop_overcharge_account_id
field.help: Income account for anything charged above what was actually disbursed, kept apart from the commission and the service fee.

field.name: clearance_commission_account_id
field.help: Where the clearance commission is credited — the percentage of the out-of-pocket total set on the service type. A subdivision of 706.

field.name: clearance_service_fee_account_id
field.help: Where the customs service fee keyed from the declaration is credited. Also a subdivision of 706, kept apart from the commission so the two revenue streams are reportable.

field.name: clearance_credit_note_title
field.help: Printed where the invoice says 'Facture doit N°'. A credit note is the same document as the invoice; this is one of the three things that differ on it.

field.name: clearance_file_fee_account_id
field.help: Where the file-opening fee is credited. The third revenue line beside the commission and the customs fee, kept on its own account so all three are reportable apart.

field.name: clearance_misc_journal_id
field.help: Used for advance justification entries.

field.name: clearance_sale_journal_id
field.help: Journal the client clearance invoice is raised in. Empty = the company's first sales journal.

field.name: account_storno
field.string: Cancellations are negated instead of swapped
field.help: OFF, which is the owner's instruction of 19/09/2026: a credit note debits what the invoice credited - debit sales, credit receivables. ON: the same entry is booked again in the SAME columns with a minus sign, which is Odoo's storno accounting. The balances are identical either way; what changes is whether the revenue account's turnover carries both movements. It applies to every credit note the company issues, not only clearance ones.

field.name: clearance_undisclosed_file_sequence_id
field.help: Where a file's reference comes from when its client is an undisclosed account. Open the sequence to set its prefix and its next number - once - and it carries on from there.

field.name: clearance_undisclosed_invoice_sequence_id
field.help: The same, for the invoices of an undisclosed account. Credit notes keep their own AV series either way.

field.name: clearance_service_tax_ids
field.help: Applied to commission, customs fees and any other service line. Disbursements are never taxed here: they are the client's own liability paid on their behalf, outside the scope of VAT.

page.p: Only the wording the printed invoice invents. The logo, NIU, RC, address and bank accounts are read from the company itself, and the client block from the customer - so there is never a second copy to keep in step.

field.name: clearance_invoice_title
field.help: Printed above the invoice number.

field.name: clearance_letterhead_tagline
field.help: Printed under the company name on the cash voucher. The logo, address, NIU, RCCM and telephone come from the company record (Settings > Companies).

field.name: clearance_cash_voucher_title
field.help: Printed above the disbursement reference on the petty-cash voucher.

field.name: clearance_invoice_vat_label
field.help: The rate is appended automatically from the tax actually charged, e.g. (19,25%).

field.name: clearance_invoice_payment_terms
field.help: Used when the invoice carries no payment term of its own.

field.name: clearance_invoice_bank_ids
field.help: Which accounts print, and in what order. Empty prints the first two the company has. Maintain the accounts themselves under Invoicing > Bank Accounts.

page.name: file_numbering
page.p: For each service, the reference of the last file opened in the old system - for example 2026IM0019. The next file opened here for that service takes the number after it: 2026IM0020.

button.name: action_open_file_numbering
button.string: Set the Last Legacy File Numbers

page.p: How long each step of the workflow may take before Reporting flags it. An advance requested on Monday and paid on Friday shows as over target, so somebody can chase it.

field.name: clearance_waiver_approver_ids
field.help: Who may sign a document waiver - the signature starts the work. Empty = any Head of Customer Service.

field.name: clearance_expense_approver_ids
field.help: Who may approve expenses before disbursement. Empty = any Clearance Manager.

field.name: clearance_settlement_approver_ids
field.help: Who may approve the payment mode, vendor, holder and journal Finance has set on an expense. Empty = any Clearance Head of Service Finance.

field.name: clearance_finance_approver_ids
field.help: Who may settle disbursements and justify advances. Empty = any Clearance Finance user.

field.name: clearance_billing_approver_ids
field.help: Who may raise client invoices and mark files complete. Empty = any Billing Agent. A name here replaces the group.

field.name: clearance_file_open_approver_ids
field.help: Who approves a file a Customer Service Agent has opened, before work can start on it. Empty = any Head of Customer Service.

field.name: clearance_file_close_approver_ids
field.help: Who closes a billed file for good. Empty = any Head of Customer Service.

field.name: clearance_reopen_approver_ids
field.help: Who may reopen a file that has been closed - for more billing, a credit note or any other adjustment. Empty = any Clearance Head of Service Operations.

field.name: clearance_ops_close_approver_ids
field.help: Who may close a file for operations. Empty = any Clearance Head of Service Operations.

field.name: clearance_justification_approver_ids
field.help: Who may approve that the documents attached to a staff advance really justify it. Empty = any Clearance Head of Service Operations.

field.name: clearance_justification_finance_approver_ids
field.help: Who signs the reclassification of a justified advance from 421101 to the billable account. Empty = any Clearance Head of Service Finance.

field.name: clearance_recharge_ops_approver_ids
field.help: Who may approve recharging the client at other than cost. Empty = any Clearance Head of Service Operations.

field.name: clearance_recharge_gm_approver_ids
field.help: Who must ALSO approve when the recharge is below what was disbursed — the company absorbs the difference. Empty = any Clearance Manager.

field.name: clearance_cashier_approver_ids
field.help: Who may disburse from a cash till once the Head of Service Finance has approved the settlement. Empty = any Clearance Cashier.

field.name: clearance_treasury_approver_ids
field.help: Who may pay from a bank or mobile-money journal once the Head of Service Finance has approved the settlement. Empty = any Clearance Treasury user.

field.name: clearance_reopen_imported_approver_ids
field.help: Who may approve reopening a file imported from the legacy system so it can be worked and billed again. Empty = any Clearance Head of Service Operations.

field.name: clearance_advance_waiver_approver_ids
field.help: Who may allow a file to be billed while a staff advance is still unsupported on 421101. Empty = any Clearance Head of Service Operations.
